name: ZexoCard Everyday Virtual Card
summary: A virtual card designed for day-to-day use, such as travel bookings, online purchases, and contactless spending.

kyc.notes: Requirements as published by the provider; confirm during onboarding.

faq.question: Does the ZexoCard Everyday Virtual Card charge a monthly fee?
faq.answer: No — there is no monthly fee. Card issuance is US$10.

faq.question: What are the foreign-exchange fees on the ZexoCard Everyday Virtual Card?
faq.answer: There is no foreign-exchange markup on spending.

faq.answer: The card network is not confirmed.
